mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k per month signals strong labor market demand, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS exceeds 200.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both residential construction starts and real personal consumption expenditures signals a broad-based demand recovery, increasing corporate revenue expectations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both HOUST and RSAFS rise simultaneously (t-test p > 0.05) or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below its 12-month moving average indicates weakening supply chain activity and reduced corporate output, leading to lower inflation expectations and positive equity returns over the next 5 trading days as markets price in earlier rate cuts.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive during INDPRO below MA periods (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% per annum signals a tightening monetary cycle, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC > -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in real personal consumption expenditures below its 6-month moving average, combined with declining housing starts, indicates a collapse in consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to earnings downgrades.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both RSAFS and HOUST fall below their 6-month MA (t-test p > 0.05) or interaction Rank IC > -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate above 7.0% and a decline in non-farm payrolls signals a labor market deterioration, reducing consumer confidence and corporate hiring, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both UNRATE > 7.0 and PAYEMS declines (t-test p > 0.05) or interaction Rank IC > -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures above 1.5% month-over-month growth, combined with rising industrial production, signals strong underlying demand momentum, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both RSAFS and INDPRO rise (t-test p > 0.05) or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
